description: This Java class 'ICalRecurConverter' converts OFBiz Temporal Expressions into iCalendar recurrence rules and date properties, facilitating the translation between internal scheduling expressions and standardized calendar data. It implements a visitor pattern to process various temporal expression types and generate corresponding iCalendar recurrence rules, date ranges, and exclusions.

classes.name: ICalRecurConverter
classes.description: Converts FOBiz Temporal Expressions to iCalendar recurrence rules and date properties.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Static method to process a TemporalExpression and populate event properties with iCalendar recurrence rules, exclusions, and date ranges.

methods.name: consolidateRecurs
methods.description: Consolidates multiple Recurrence objects into a single Recurrence with merged properties for simplified, combined recurrence rules.
